model: Current live economy with continuous writing enabled; shared tuning controls extracted without changing values
policy: Five-second decisions; highest base-wage progression except the explicitly labelled current-wage control; lowest-level eligible skill; sustainable affordable equipment; balanced prose in the first genre; no potion. Transition switches to 80% writing at 600 real seconds.
limitations: Heuristic policies, not optimal play. Uses away-style production update order with at most one-second steps and publication/year/retirement boundaries. Majority is measured over complete game-year buckets, not a rolling window. Stops after 120 real minutes per life if not retired; only retired lives inherit. Readership and declining sales are not implemented yet.
